reviews.comment:
Me acerco para ver si está disponible el compresor para controlar los neumáticos y una Sra  me empieza a gritar que no que no que no. (No entendí. nada).  Aparentemente no se podía inflar los neumáticos por qué estaban repostando combustible. Ningún señalamiento, nada! sólo una sra gritando. Una actualizada al sigloXX les vendría bien! Una pena.

(Translated by Google)
I went over to see if the compressor was available to check the tires, and a woman started yelling at me, saying no, no, no! (I didn't understand anything.) Apparently, they couldn't inflate the tires because they were refueling. No signs, nothing! Just a woman yelling. They could really use an update to the 20th century! What a shame.
